response.query: What sampling frame (jurisdictions, industries, company sizes) and minimum sample size produce 80–90% power to detect CGU/component mismatch prevalence and DTA/DTL misstatements?
response.answer: To achieve 80–90% power for detecting CGU/component mismatch prevalence and DTA/DTL misstatements, sample across diverse industries and company sizes, with a minimum sample size of 200-300 units.
